mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals increased consumer confidence and economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over two months signals a supply shock or economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure, which leads to monetary tightening and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both proxies show the expected trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 3% over two months signals increased consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a falling consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a successful monetary policy in controlling inflation, which stabilizes economic conditions and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both proxies show the expected trend.
